privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.contentHtml:
1. Data Controller

The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:

Klacks Software
Heribert Gasparoli
Kirchstrasse 52
CH-3097 Liebefeld, Switzerland
Email: hgasparoli@hotmail.com

2. Hosting and Server Logs

This website is operated on servers of Hetzner Online GmbH (Germany). For technical reasons, access data is processed in server log files when the website is accessed (IP address, time of access, page accessed, browser identifier). This data is used exclusively for the secure operation of the website and is not combined with other data sources. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a stable and secure operation.

For displaying pages, the website uses a persistent connection to the server (WebSocket/SignalR). No personal data beyond the server logs is stored in the process.

3. No Cookies, No Tracking, No Third Parties

This website does not use cookies, does not use any analytics or tracking tool, and does not load any content from third parties. Fonts and icons are delivered locally from our own server; your IP address is not transmitted to third parties (e.g. Google Fonts).

4. Contact by Email

If you contact us by email, we process the information you provide (email address, content of the message) in order to respond to your inquiry. The data is not stored in a database and is not shared with third parties.

5. Playground Instance

The Playground instance of Klacks linked from this website is a public test environment. Do not enter any real personal data there — all data in the Playground instance is automatically reset on a regular basis. The privacy policy available within the application also applies to the Playground instance.

6. Your Rights

Under the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG) and — where applicable — the DSGVO, you have the following rights:

  • Access: You may request information about your stored personal data.
  • Rectification: You may request the correction of inaccurate data.
  • Erasure: You may request the deletion of your data, provided no statutory retention obligations apply.
  • Restriction and objection: You may object to the processing or request its restriction.
  • Complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (in Switzerland: EDÖB).

To exercise your rights, please contact the controller named above.

7. Changes

This privacy policy may be amended at any time. The current version is always available on this page.
